name: Luma
sourceSpeciesReference: User-provided Muse mascot reference; exact body composition, species, proportions, limb structure, posture, and silhouette are immutable.

identity.bodyRule: Never redesign Luma's body. Customization is additive only: accents, clothing, accessories, pose, expression, and environmental interaction.
identity.presence: Luma appears in every MUSE-UM room as a guide, curator, and companion, but does not need to occupy the same pose or visual prominence in each room.

carriedSet.curatorCollar: Slim amber/brass collar; the warm MUSE-UM signature accent.
carriedSet.starlightMedallion: Small dangling starlight relic medallion attached to the collar.
carriedSet.guideItem: Compact lantern pouch or tiny pocket relic, carried or worn as the guide/companion cue.

generationRequirements.method: Codex built-in image_gen, using the canonical reference as image input.
generationRequirements.invariantPrompt: Preserve Luma's exact same species and body composition. Change only pose, expression, setting, and the defined carried set.
